title: Request
description: Unary Revise input. All calls are dry runs against the load; only Foundry stores a version.

definition.description: Parent definition; its draft items are authoritative.

edits.description: One to 100 distinct edits, at most 1 MiB of TOML in total.

eval.description: Current servable load, if the worker has one.

Definition.description: The complete immutable definition, with serialized JSON strings as Foundry stores them.

draft_json.description: DraftView JSON with its inner questions stored separately below.

mappings_toml.description: Rendered mappings, checked against the draft items.

ontology_toml.description: Rendered ontology, checked against the draft items.

Edit.description: A user edit. Unknown item strings reach policy and return `EditNotAllowed`.

oneOf.description: Add or replace one complete item snippet.

item_id.description:
An extraction route, rule, constraint or the People enrichment item; an existing
type, with new identifiers or props the enrichment item fills; or the new link its
work history states.

oneOf.description: Remove an existing extraction route, rule, constraint or People enrichment item.

item_id.description: The extraction route, rule, constraint or People enrichment item to remove.

Eval.description:
The current load, to measure the revision on, and its read-only proxy. Credentials never
appear in Debug output.

helix.description: Where the graph is read: the backend's read-only proxy.

load.description: The load read: the id of the job that created it.

mappings_toml.description:
The `mappings.toml` of the load's version: the targets and work history link of its
`[enrichments]` item, if it has one, are what the load holds values of only from the
profiles it applied, so a constraint over them isn't measured on it ([`load::unheld`]).
One that doesn't parse refuses the revision, as an `ontology_toml` that doesn't does.

ontology_toml.description:
The `ontology.toml` of the load's version: the revision is measured on the load only
if it keeps its types, links and properties ([`comparable`]), and an item only if it
reads none the version lacks ([`load::unheld`]).

ontology_version.description:
The version the load records; a load of another version, or one being deleted, is no
comparable load.

HelixTarget.description: Where the graph is written: the backend's proxy for one Helix database.

max_request_bytes.description: The largest request body the proxy takes; a write past it is refused before it is sent.

timeout_secs.description: How long one request may take, in seconds.

token.description: The job's bearer token for the proxy.

LoadId.description: One load of an approved version into a graph: the id of the backend job that creates it, such as a ULID. One or more printable ASCII characters, no space.
